events.headline: Peloton discloses planned departure of Chief Accounting Officer Saqib Baig
events.summary: Baig notified Peloton on October 8 that he would leave November 27, 2026 for an external opportunity; a successor search is underway for this financial-reporting leadership role. Peloton reported no accounting-related disagreements.

excerpts: On October 8, 2026, Saqib Baig, the Chief Accounting Officer and principal accounting officer of Peloton Interactive, Inc. (the “Company”), notified the Company of his decision to step down from his position to pursue an external opportunity.
Baig will continue to serve in his role until November 27, 2026. The Company has initiated a search of potential candidates for the role.
Baig’s departure is not the result of any disagreements or issues relating to financial disclosures or accounting matters.
